protocol: Synthetic task-specified context_length >= 9216 infeasibility, not a claim of actual OOM; unavailable native objectives stay null. Sobol samples table row indices; a table-aware sampler repairs proposals before Optuna records them. Exact observed joint vectors are always stored and evaluated. No holdout or out-of-sample claim.
repair_metric: RMS of per-knob min-max normalized numeric distance and categorical mismatch
